title: 退款影响与渠道利润风险
context: 电商＋财务联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年线上渠道，退款率=退款/折后退款前销售额，退货后毛利，以及退款前毛利估算（原销售成本加回退货原成本）；按退款率降序，分母为0返回NULL。
commonError: 只减退款不冲回退货成本会误算毛利。
executionSteps: 会话内分别汇总原销售与净销售
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT o.session_id,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents) gross_revenue,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents) original_cost FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.status='completed' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.session_id), b AS (SELECT session_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY session_id) SELECT s.source_id,SUM(a.gross_revenue) before_refund_cents,SUM(b.refund) refund_cents,ROUND(100.0*SUM(b.refund)/NULLIF(SUM(a.gross_revenue),0),2) refund_pct,SUM(a.gross_revenue-a.original_cost) before_gross_cents,SUM(b.net-b.cost) after_gross_cents FROM customer_sessions s JOIN a ON a.session_id=s.session_id JOIN b ON b.session_id=s.session_id GROUP BY s.source_id ORDER BY refund_pct DESC,s.source_id
